project_type: Full-stack TypeScript - Vite React SPA + Express API on Supabase
build_system: npm with vite (frontend) + esbuild (server.ts bundle). Must source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh before any npm commands.
test_framework: No test runner configured - verification via tsc --noEmit (lint) and vite build
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run lint (tsc --noEmit). 2. Run npm run build (vite build + esbuild server.ts). Both must exit 0.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node.js v22 via nvm. No test framework - validation through tsc and build only.
contribution_requirements: Push directly to main branch. Meaningful commit messages.
key_patterns: Server routes registered in server/app.ts via registerXxxRoutes(app, supabase). Supabase client initialized centrally. Frontend uses AppContext for auth/state. Pages in src/pages/, components in src/components/. Inline translation via t(en, mr) pattern. Migrations in supabase/migrations/ with naming convention YYYYMMDDNNNN_description.sql.
directory_structure: Root: package.json, server.ts, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json. src/: React app with pages/, components/, contexts/. server/: Express API modules (auth, data, agents, whatsapp-bot, whatsapp-webhook, calling-agent, security, app). supabase/migrations/: SQL migration files.
